entries.title: Private civic portal activated in production
entries.summary: The production civic portal now supports authenticated private citizen access. The Founder's civic profile, encrypted Learning evidence, source contracts, evaluations, recommendations, profile media, and related protected records were migrated from the isolated local v3 environment into production. Editorial Studio and analytics authority are enforced server-side and remain available only through the Founder's authorized civic profile. A pre-migration database backup was retained, protected files were transferred to encrypted civic storage, referential integrity was verified, and the complete 65-test release suite passed before publication.
